label: Applying to a Portuguese public university through the national contest, autumn 2027

milestones.label: Get the equivalence certificate for your IB Diploma
milestones.note: Issued by a Portuguese secondary school or the Direção-Geral da Educação, with the final grade on the 0–200 scale. Documents need an apostille and a Portuguese translation. Start early.

milestones.label: CNAES publishes which foreign exams replace the Portuguese entrance exams
milestones.note: Published by this date each year. Until then you cannot be sure which IB subjects will count for your degree.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: Before the national contest opens, so you apply with real results.

milestones.label: 1st phase closes for candidates substituting foreign exams — the IB candidate's deadline
milestones.note: In 2026 this group applied 20–29 July, a week before the 6 August date other candidates had. The 2027 calendar is set by its own despacho, usually in July.

milestones.label: 1st phase placements
milestones.note: 23 August in 2026, with only four days to enrol after it. Second and third phases follow into October.

notes: The dated 2026 events stay in the country profile's deadlines with their year; the route records 2027 as not yet announced rather than carrying a year forward.
